title: Canonical base-change compatibility of the degree-zero cup pairing
statement: Let f:X→S, j:W→S and h:T→W be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] and E any O_X-module. Assume the tensor-pullback adjunction units at O_W and O_T for p_W and p_T are invertible [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let φ_W,φ_T be the explicit cup transposes [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map], and β_E,β_(E^∨) the specified direct-image base-change maps [lem-sc-picard-canonical-base-change-comparisons]. Then (β_E⊗β_(E^∨)) followed by uncurry φ_T equals the tensor-comparison inverse followed by h^*(uncurry φ_W) and the unit comparison h^*O_W≅O_T. No invertibility of β, rank condition or finite local freeness is assumed.

proof.text: Expand picardCupProductMap and cancel uncurry with curry. Both pairings are the explicit picardPushforwardPairing formed from the pulled evaluation of E and dual E.

Take the adjoint along p_T of both sides. Expand the canonical base-change maps as mates of the top pullback unit, followed by the specified tensor-composition comparison. Naturality of the unit and counit and their triangle identities identify each base-change map followed by the p_T counit with the pullback of the p_W counit. The two adjoints are the same evaluation pulled to X_T and applied to these two counits. Tensor-comparison naturality and associativity commute all comparison maps. The structure-unit comparison is compatible because its section formula is m mapped to 1 tensor m; inverse units are compatible by invertibility. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence proves the displayed pairing equality. The calculation applies to zero objects and empty schemes, and uses no flatness.

lean.statement:
theorem picardCupPairing_baseChange
    {X S W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (E : X.Modules)
    (j : W ⟶ S) (h : T ⟶ W)
    (hO : IsIso ((Classical.choose
      (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f j))).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hOT : IsIso ((Classical.choose
      (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f (h ≫ j)))).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) :
    ((Modules.picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap f j h E) ⊗ₘ
        (Modules.picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap f j h (Modules.dual E))) ≫
      MonoidalClosed.uncurry (picardCupProductMap f E (h ≫ j) hOT) =
    (Modules.picardTensorObjIso h
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj E))
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj (Modules.dual E)))).inv ≫
      (Modules.tensorPullback h).map (MonoidalClosed.uncurry (picardCupProductMap f E j hO)) ≫
        (Modules.picardTensorUnitIso h).hom
